title: On Global Joint Lower Bounds in Zeroth-Order Nonconvex Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.19652v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent work has sought to transfer first-order nonconvex optimization guarantees to zeroth-order methods through gradient estimators, typically incurring a factor linear in $d$. \citet{kornowski2024} obtained an $\mathcal{O}(d\delta^{-1}\epsilon^{-3})$ oracle complexity for nonsmooth nonconvex optimization and asked whether its dependence on all three parameters is jointly optimal. Although the dimension dependence and the first-order dependence on $(\delta,\epsilon)$ are separately known to be unavoidable, a matching zeroth-order lower bound has remained open. We answer this question in the unrestricted full-space setting. For smooth stochastic nonconvex optimization, we establish a scalar-oracle lower bound of $\Omega\!\left(dL_0^2\min\{\Delta H,L_0^2\}/\epsilon^4\right)$ assuming a smooth, globally lower-bounded population objective and a second-moment bound on sample Lipschitz constants. translated_title: 关于零阶非凸优化中的全局联合下界
translated_abstract: 近期的研究工作试图通过梯度估计器将一阶非凸优化的保证转移到零阶方法上，这通常会产生与维度 $d$ 呈线性关系的因子。Kornowski 等人（2024）针对非光滑非凸优化获得了 $\mathcal{O}(d\delta^{-1}\epsilon^{-3})$ 的预言机复杂度，并提出了其关于这三个参数的依赖关系是否联合最优的问题。尽管关于维度的依赖性以及对 $(\delta,\epsilon)$ 的一阶依赖性已被分别证明是不可避免的，但与之匹配的零阶下界一直悬而未决。我们在无限制的全空间设置中回答了这个问题。对于光滑随机非凸优化，在假设种群目标函数光滑且全局下有界、以及样本 Lipschitz 常数满足二阶矩有界的条件下，我们建立了标量预言机下界 $\Omega(dL_0^2\min\{\Delta H,L_0^2\}/\epsilon^4)$。随后通过一个光滑化归，进一步得到了一个下界……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文在无限制全空间设置下为光滑随机非凸优化建立了标量预言机全局联合下界，回答了零阶方法复杂度关于维度、光滑化参数和精度的依赖是否联合最优这一公开问题。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes a global joint scalar-oracle lower bound for smooth stochastic nonconvex optimization in the unrestricted full-space setting, resolving the open question of whether the complexity of zeroth-order methods can jointly achieve optimality in its dependence on dimension, smoothing parameter, and accuracy.
